title: Flutter & Node.js Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) - Fully Remote
description:
memodio is a digital health application (DiGA) fighting forgetfulness and dementia 🧠 Our app is prescribed by doctors, fully reimbursed by German statutory health insurance, and recommended by leading medical associations. In a clinical trial with 140 participants, we showed that it measurably improves memory performance, everyday independence, and quality of life. More than 10,000 people already trust memodio.

We've been on the market for over five years. So we have the speed and ownership culture of a startup, without the chaotic early days: a validated product, paying reimbursement partners, and real users who notice when we ship something good. Now we're growing the engineering team.

Where you sit: anywhere in the world. We're a small distributed team, not a company with a remote policy bolted on. The one requirement is overlap: at least four hours of your working day between 09:00 and 18:00 Berlin time, because we solve problems together, not by throwing tickets over a wall.

How you join us: as an employee or as a freelancer, whichever fits your situation better. Tell us which you'd prefer when you apply.

Tasks

Our core product is live and helping thousands of people, but it's far from finished. A big part of this role is evolving the existing app to better fit the people who actually use it: adults aged 50+, often dealing with early-stage cognitive decline. Every improvement you make has a direct, visible effect on someone's day.

Beyond the core product we're building new and adjacent products, including ones with AI capabilities. If working with LLMs excites you, there's real room to shape that. If it doesn't, that's fine too.

How the role works

You won't get finished designs and implementation specs to execute. You'll get problems, context, and user needs and the freedom to figure out the best solution. That's deliberate: it's where the creativity and the ownership live. It also means the job asks you to think about what to build, not only how.

Today our CTO is hands-on in the codebase, supported by a part-time engineer. You'd join as the next full-time engineer on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.

Day to day

  • Frontend: evolve our Flutter app (iOS & Android), with a strong focus on good UX and usability for people aged 50+
  • Backend: design and build our Node.js APIs and services for new features
  • Product: work closely with our medical and product colleagues: your voice matters in what we build and how
  • Quality: help us keep code review, testing, and engineering standards at the level a regulated medical product demands
  • Optional: if DevOps interests you, there's room to shape our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment but it isn't the core of the job

Requirements

What you bring

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, and we care far more about what you've actually shipped than about the number. Show us something you built
  • Flutter/Dart skills, or a proven ability to ramp up fast (e.g. coming from React Native or native mobile)
  • Working knowledge of Node.js and building APIs, you don't have to be equally strong on both ends, but you can't be mobile-only
  • You work well remotely and asynchronously. This is a distributed role on a tiny team. You write clearly, you post updates without being asked, you unblock yourself, and you don't go quiet for two days
  • At least four hours of daily overlap with 09:00–17:00 Berlin time (CET/CEST)
  • You're comfortable working from underspecified problems. As a small company we can't hand you full designs and implementation plans — you'll need to ask the right questions, propose solutions, and make calls. In return, you get creative freedom
  • A self-directed, structured way of working, you thrive with a lot of ownership and little supervision
  • Dedication: we don't do inhumane startup hours, but when it matters - a release, a deadline, a critical fix
  • Fluent English, written and spoken. German is a plus, not a requirement

Nice to have, not required

  • Interest or experience in software security, our product passed an intense security audit and we intend to keep that bar high
  • Experience with accessibility, or with building for older users
  • Experience with DiGA, medical devices, or other regulated environments
  • Startup or consultancy background
  • DevOps experience (CI/CD, cloud infrastructure)

You are probably not right if

  • You need a large team around you. For now it's you, a hands-on CTO, and a part-time engineer. Specialists to hand things off to come later, you'll help hire them
  • You're looking for greenfield-only work. A big part of this job is improving a live product with real users and real constraints
  • You need someone to hand you tickets, or a manager checking in daily. Remote and self-directed is the whole shape of this role
  • You see your scope as highly specialised. We need technical solutions for internal tooling here and there too. If touching a HubSpot integration feels beneath you, this isn't the right place

Benefits

What we offer

  • Purpose: your code measurably helps people — clinically proven, prescribed by doctors, reimbursed by statutory health insurance
  • Real ownership: as the next full-time engineer, you'll own features end to end and have a direct say in how we build
  • Stability with startup energy: 5+ years on the market, revenue from reimbursement partners
  • Genuinely remote, genuinely worldwide: work from wherever you're based, with flexible hours around a light overlap window. Our office in Potsdam is there if you ever want it
  • Your choice of setup: employment or freelance, whichever suits you
  • No office politics: a small, focused team where the energy goes into the product, not into positioning
  • Straight talk: you've just read our salary range and a list of reasons not to apply. That's how we operate internally too

If you have any questions, please don't hestitate to reach out :)
The initial phase will be a short questionnaire, followed by a small project and 1-2 live interview rounds.

Shiftmove exists to make this simple. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, audio technology, and product quality.

At HOLOPLOT, software is central to the design, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operation of sound systems.

Our show production team has been working on a wide range of audio applications/plugins for immersive audio content production that will work hand in hand with our sound system. Testing such applications and plugins requires more than checking whether features work. It requires an understanding of signal flow, timing, synchronization, real-time constraints, interoperability, and how audio systems fail in practice. It also requires creating representable mocks and setups that are effective, economical, and maintainable.

You will help integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve the reliability, runtime, debuggability, and maintainability of the test suite.

You will create test tools that make it easier to automatically capture, analyze, compare, and validate audio behavior.

You will help teams move from manual validation toward reproducible, deterministic, and observable test workflows.

  • A proven track record as a Software Development Engineer in Test, or Software Engineer with a strong focus on quality and automation.

  • Experience with spatial audio technologies.

  • Experience testing multi-channel audio systems or large-scale professional audio installations.

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you will own the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


This is not a traditional RevOps or analytics role.


We are looking for a builder who can understand a commercial problem in the morning and start shipping a solution in the afternoon. You will combine software engineering, automation, AI, data, and commercial thinking to make our GTM organization faster and more effective.


You will have significant ownership over how autarc builds its GTM infrastructure as we scale across Europe.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Build our GTM operating system

Own and continuously improve the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Deploy AI into real workflows

Move AI beyond prototypes.

Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Own GTM data & analytics

Create a reliable data foundation for our commercial organization.

Connect and structure data across our CRM, calling infrastructure, product, billing, and other GTM systems.

Build dashboards and internal tools that give teams real-time visibility into the metrics that matter: pipeline, activity, conversion, ARR, retention, and individual and team performance.

Make sure we can answer important commercial questions with data rather than assumptions.


Build, don’t just recommend

You will personally implement what you design.

Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

Technology is a means, not the outcome.

Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and can independently ship solutions using Python and/or TypeScript.

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs.

  • You understand modern AI tooling and have already built applications or workflows using LLMs.

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.

  • You understand how modern B2B SaaS companies generate revenue and are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems connecting them.

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification.

  • You prioritize commercial impact over technical perfection.

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have previously worked as a GTM Engineer, Growth Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, RevOps Engineer, or in a similarly hands-on technical role.

  • You have experience with B2B SaaS GTM stacks and tools such as HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms.

  • You have built internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You understand data modeling and have experience building a data warehouse or analytics infrastructure.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

A high-ownership role with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure from the ground up instead of maintaining legacy systems.

Direct collaboration with our founders and GTM leadership.

A fast-moving environment where you can ship and test ideas quickly.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

title: Software Engineer - Data (All Genders)
description:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


Main information

  • Start: Immediately
  • Location: Cologne, Berlin London or Remote
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Teamwear/Tech


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • 100% remote: This role is generally available 100% remote within the EU or UK. If you'd still love to work from one of our offices in Cologne, Berlin or London - you're more than welcome.
  • Experience: You bring 6-8 years of experience in software engineering and data engineering.
  • Languages: You speak English fluently - German is a big plus.
  • Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap.


Your playing field

Here's why this role matters for our mission.

  • Teamwear is one of our three company headlines, but technically it currently depends on one person.
  • As long as this remains the case, the area cannot scale beyond its current scope.
  • Your goal: To enable Teamwear to scale beyond its current scope.


How you'll make a difference

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly.
  • Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images.
  • Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners.
  • Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area.
  • Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area.
In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
  • Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves.
  • Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners.


What you bring to the table

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis.
  • Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing.
  • Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling.
  • Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams.
  • Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way.
  • 80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it.
  • Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit.
  • Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked.
  • Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews.
  • Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you.
    • You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers.
    • You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. This gives you a lot of freedom and means you need to set your own priorities.
    • A large part of the role is data collection and data quality, rather than greenfield ML. The exciting part is turning messy, real-world sources into reliable data.
    • The area is new. There is no finished setup for you to work with - you will help build it.
    • AI-first: We work AI-first, and AI tools are an active part of our workflow.


Bonus

Not a must - but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes or IaC (Pulumi/Terraform). You can also learn this with us.
  • Experience presenting and preparing data for non-technical audiences.
  • A personal connection to amateur football.


Benefits

We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now. 

  • Be part of it from the start – Shape how Prematch grows and transforms amateur football.
  • Competitive salary – You’ll be paid fairly and transparently.
  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
  • Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team spirit - whether in the office or at home, we use cool tools and a virtual office to keep the team tightly connected.
  • Modern IT equipment - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.


Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.

If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.
Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us.

Now it's your turn.

  • Click on ‘Apply now’ - it’ll only take 2 minutes.
  • All we need is your CV. You can tell us the rest in our simple, short application form.
  • Don’t meet all the requirements? If you think you’re still a good fit - just apply

  • Ort: 100 % Remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für die EU ist Voraussetzung.

Deine Mission: Hier übernimmst Du Verantwortung!

Passt Du zu uns?

  • HRIS-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits mit einem modernen HRIS gearbeitet – aus der Administration, nicht nur aus der Nutzersicht (z. B. Personio, HiBob, BambooHR, Leapsome). Leapsome-Erfahrung ist ein klares Plus, da wir es aktuell zur führenden Datenquelle für unsere Personaldaten ausbauen; Erfahrung mit Join ist ein weiteres Plus.
  • Teamplayer*in im Remote-Setup: Du arbeitest gerne remote und schätzt den engen Austausch mit dem Company Resources Team und dem Management.
  • Klare Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung – Du kommunizierst verständlich mit Kolleg*innen auf allen Ebenen, im In- und Ausland.

Benefits

  • Sinn & Impact: Du arbeitest in einem Unternehmen, dessen Kerngeschäft Klimaschutz ist – und hältst dabei die Strukturen zusammen, ohne die niemand von uns arbeiten könnte.

Das Ergebnis: Als einzige Plattform ihrer Art in Deutschland kooperieren wir bereits mit über 80 Krankenkassen, die die Kosten für unsere Nutzerinnen übernehmen. Seit 2017 haben wir so schon mehr als 1.000.000 Mütter durch die ersten zwei Lebensjahre ihres Babys begleitet.
Wir arbeiten datengetrieben, transparent und mit dem klaren Anspruch, gemeinsam als Team den Zugang zu Wissen in dieser besonderen Zeit durch eine Integration ins Gesundheitssystem für alle Frauen und Familien zu ermöglichen.

Aufgaben

Die Rolle

Du möchtest nach deinen ersten Berufsjahren mehr Verantwortung übernehmen, näher an einem Produkt arbeiten und mit deiner Arbeit sichtbare Wirkung erzielen?

Als Business Development Manager entwickelst du gemeinsam mit unseren Krankenkassenpartnern bestehende Partnerschaften strategisch weiter und sorgst dafür, dass unsere digitalen Gesundheitsangebote noch mehr Frauen und Familien erreichen (B2B2C).

Dabei verbindest du Relationship Management mit analytischem und wachstumsorientiertem Denken. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Partnern, Product Growth, Marketing und unserer Chief Revenue Officer zusammen und übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Projekte.

Wenn du nach deinen ersten Jahren im Startup, Scale-up, Consulting oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld den nächsten Entwicklungsschritt suchst und Lust hast, nicht nur Empfehlungen auszusprechen, sondern selbst umzusetzen, könnte diese Rolle sehr gut zu dir passen.

Als Business Development Manager übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren bestehenden Krankenkassenpartnern.

description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software and data infrastructure, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own and continuously improve our characterization analysis software suite

  • Develop new analysis methods as experiments and measurement capabilities evolve

  • Build and maintain reliable, scalable data infrastructure

  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analysis outputs

  • Turn raw measurement data into actionable insights for process and design decisions

  • Extract device parameters from measured data and benchmark results against physical and compact models

  • Perform statistical process and yield analyses to identify trends, correlations, and outliers across wafers and lots

  • Correlate characterization results with process parameters, closing the loop between measurement and process control

  • Integrate analysis outputs with fab MES and data systems to enable real-time process feedback

  • Define standardized analysis protocols and transition mature R&D code into robust, production-ready tools

  • Optimize analysis pipelines for throughput and scalability as we move toward high-volume production

Your Qualifications

  • An M.S. or PhD in Data Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline

  • At least two years of relevant industry or research experience; a related PhD project

  • Strong Python skills and a genuine passion for building high-quality software

  • A proven track record of designing, developing, and owning a software pipeline or technical project end-to-end

  • A solid foundation in device physics, including solid-state physics, semiconductor devices, and photonics

  • Experience with statistical analysis, model fitting, and parameter extraction

  • Experience with data visualization and tracking trends across wafers, lots, or manufacturing processes

  • The ability to work with laboratory or fab instrument interfaces

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events
description:
Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events

Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Unsere Mission für dich

Du baust den Kanal, über den trawa dem industriellen Mittelstand begegnet: mehr als 30 Messen, Kongresse und Roundtables im Jahr, von der fünftägigen Leitmesse bis zum Fachkongress auf sechs Quadratmetern. Du entscheidest mit, welche davon stattfinden, führst sie durch und stehst für das Ergebnis ein.

Es bleibt nicht beim Stand. Du baust die Landingpage, bewirbst die Events in Paid und Content und schreibst den LinkedIn-Post zur Messewoche. In kurzer Zeit kennst du den kompletten Weg von der Standfläche bis zur Opportunity im CRM — eine Breite, die dir ein großes Marketingteam nicht bietet.

Europas B2B-Sektor gibt jährlich über 200 Milliarden Euro für Energie aus. Die Zeit, diesen Markt zu dekarbonisieren und unsere Markenbekanntheit zu steigern, ist jetzt.


Das Team

Neben dir sitzen Content, Growth und Product Marketing — Events sind der Kanal, an dem alle drei zusammenlaufen.

Gleichzeitig bist du näher an Sales als die meisten Marketingrollen. Auf jeder Messe stehen Seller mit am Stand, und der Wert eines Events entsteht erst, wenn aus Gesprächen Termine werden. Du stimmst dich laufend mit Sales, SDRs und Revenue Operations ab.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du ownst den Eventkalender. Welche Messe, welches Format, welches Budget. Du planst das Jahr, rechnest jedes Event durch und sagst ab, wenn die Zahl nicht stimmt.

  • Du baust den Auftritt. Standfläche, Standbau, Grafik, Technik, Logistik. Du verhandelst mit Messegesellschaften und Dienstleistern, hältst die Fristen ein und stehst vor Ort selbst am Stand.

  • Du machst aus Standtagen Termine. Einladungskampagnen, Teilnehmerlisten, Matchmaking, Terminsetzung vorab. Danach: Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass und Übergabe an Sales entlang eines klaren SLA.

  • Du misst deine eigene Arbeit. Landingpages, Formulare, HubSpot-Workflows, Lead-Tagging und Reporting baust du selbst — und berichtest MQLs, Pipeline und Signings je Event gegen Plan.

  • Du bleibst nicht bei Events. Newsletter, LinkedIn, PR und eigene Formate gehören dazu, bis hin zu Guerilla-Experimenten wie Briefkampagnen oder OOH. Was funktioniert, wiederholen wir.

Nach wem wir suchen

  • Ein bis vier Jahre B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Events oder Messen, gern mit Bezug zum deutschen Mittelstand

  • Du bist extrovertiert: Auf dem Stand gehst du auf Menschen zu, statt zu warten, bis jemand stehen bleibt. Viele Gespräche am Tag geben dir Energie

  • Du behältst den Überblick, wenn ein Dutzend Dienstleister und mehrere Messen parallel laufen – und eskalierst rechtzeitig

  • Du denkst kaufmännisch und bewertest ein Event an dem, was es an Pipeline bringt

  • Du baust dir Landingpage, Formular und Reporting selbst

  • Bias to Action: lieber schnell testen und messen als lange konzipieren

  • Deutsch muttersprachlich, gutes Englisch

  • Berlin oder Umzug dorthin, plus Reisebereitschaft in der Messesaison und einen Führerschein

Deine ersten 90 Tage:

Nach sechs Wochen: Onboarding

  • Du hast trawas Geschäftsmodell, Produkt und Zielgruppe im Detail verstanden und alle relevanten Stakeholder in Marketing und Sales kennengelernt.

  • Du hast das laufende Eventportfolio übernommen, kennst jeden offenen Punkt und jede Frist und hast die Abläufe dokumentiert.

  • Du warst auf allen Messen vor Ort, die in dieser Zeit stattfanden, und hast konkrete Verbesserungen benannt und erste Verantwortung übernommen.

Im dritten Monat: Ramp-up

  • Du verantwortest eigene Key Results im neuen Planungszyklus und lässt dich an den erzielten Ergebnissen messen.

  • Du hast die Planung für das kommende Halbjahr aufgesetzt, jedes Event durchgerechnet und einen Entscheidungsvorschlag vorgelegt.

  • Ein wiederverwendbarer Ablauf steht: Vorlauf, Aktivierung, Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass — nachvollziehbar genug, dass jemand anderes ihn ausführen könnte..

Warum wir?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben.

  • Dein Impact: Jede Messe bringt uns mit Unternehmen zusammen, deren Energiekosten wir senken und deren Verbrauch wir dekarbonisieren.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Das Event-Marketing bei trawa ist im Aufbau. Du erbst keine fertigen Strukturen, sondern etablierst sie.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Dich erwartet ein schönes Büro in Berlin mit einer lebendigen Unternehmenskultur. Homeoffice und flexible Arbeitszeiten sind möglich, 30 Urlaubstage unterstützen deine Work-Life-Balance.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Weiterbildungstage, ein jährliches L&D-Budget und Coaching-Sessions über Sparrks.

  • Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung.

 

Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft.

 

Über uns

Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite.

description:

CUREosity ist ein innovatives Med-Tech-Startup aus Düsseldorf, das die Gesundheitsbranche mit Virtual-Reality-Therapien revolutioniert. Unsere mehrfach ausgezeichneten Lösungen verbessern die Rehabilitation für Patient*innen weltweit.

title: Technical Project & Support Consultant (f/m/d) – Legal Software
description:
Short description

Do you enjoy guiding customers throughout their entire journey, from the initial software implementation to long-term success?
In this hybrid role, you will combine project management, technical support, and customer success to ensure that our clients in the legal sector achieve maximum value from our solutions.
As the central point of contact between customers and internal teams, you will manage projects from planning through go-live, resolve technical challenges, and build long-term, trusted customer relationships.
Does this sound like the right challenge for you? Then we'd love to get to know you.
Your workplace / location:
Work at one of our offices in Germany remotely from anywhere in Germany.


Your mission

Implementation & Project Management

  • Guide customers through the implementation of our Legal Software and manage implementation projects from planning to successful go-live.
  • Analyze customer requirements and develop suitable solution and implementation concepts together with the customer.
  • Conduct workshops, document requirements, and coordinate their implementation.
  • Manage project plans, milestones, resources, and risks.
  • Act as the central interface between customers and our Product, Development, and Support teams.
  • Support data migrations, system configurations, and individual customer requirements.
Technical Support & Solution Consulting
  • Handle complex customer inquiries within 2nd-level support.
  • Analyze technical issues and support root cause analysis in databases, log files, and existing systems.
  • Work closely with our technical teams to develop sustainable solutions.
  • Support customers with technical questions related to our software solutions.
Customer Care & Customer Success
  • Support customers throughout their entire lifecycle, from implementation to productive day-to-day use.
  • Deliver customer training sessions and end-user workshops.
  • Identify optimization opportunities and advise customers on improving their processes.
  • Ensure our customers achieve long-term success with our solutions.


Your profile

  • You have at least 3 years of professional experience in a comparable role, such as Application Consultant, Implementation Consultant, Technical Consultant, IT Project Manager, Support Consultant, or Customer Success Manager within a software environment.
  • A degree in Information Technology or a comparable qualification; a legal background is considered a plus.
  • Experience working with project management methodologies and tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Wrike.
  • Strong technical understanding of software applications, databases, and system landscapes.
  • Practical SQL skills and the ability to create and analyze database queries.
  • Ideally, you have experience in technical troubleshooting and can understand existing code structures to help identify root causes.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Dynamics.
  • Excellent German and English language skills; French is a plus.
  • A structured and analytical working style, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Confident communication skills when working with customers and a variety of stakeholders.
  • Experience in SaaS, software, or Legal Tech environments is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and collaboration with international teams.

title: Ausbildung Fachinformatiker:in für Systemintegration (all genders) - Standort Nabburg
description:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group sucht die teccle motion engagierte Auszubildende zum/zur Fachinformatiker:in Systemintegration (all genders) ab 01.09.2027.

Für uns sind Auszubildende von Anfang an Kolleg:innen auf Augenhöhe. Wir legen Wert auf eine praxisnahe Ausbildung, persönliche Förderung und ein starkes Miteinander im Team. Bei erfolgreichem Abschluss deiner Ausbildung bieten wir dir gerne die Möglichkeit zur Übernahme und langfristige Perspektiven bei der teccle group. #letsteccleit

Was du bei uns lernst

Bei uns arbeitest du praxisnah, wirst Teil eines Teams und wächst mit deinen Aufgaben. Das erwartet dich in deiner Ausbildung:

  • Praxisnahe Arbeit mit modernen IT-Systemen - von Client- bis Server-Architekturen

  • IT-Systeme und Netzwerke planen, aufbauen und am Laufen halten - damit alles rund läuft

  • Netzwerktechnologien anwenden und vertiefen sowie Hosting- und Cloud-Lösungen nutzen

  • Hard- und Software einrichten, testen und pflegen - Hightech zum Anfassen inklusive

  • IT-Sicherheit im Blick behalten und Systeme so absichern, dass Hacker keine Chance haben

  • Fehler finden, Probleme lösen und Systeme optimieren - mit Köpfchen und Teamgeist

  • Dokumentationen erstellen und Anwender:innen unterstützen, damit Technik für alle verständlich bleibt

  • Spannende Einblicke in wichtige Unternehmensbereiche wie Vertrieb und Buchhaltung

  • IT-Fachkenntnisse vertiefen und ausbauen mit Unterstützung erfahrener IT-Expert:innen sowie durch regelmäßige Workshops und Schulungen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Begeisterung mitbringst, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du kannst einen mindestens guten Schulabschluss vorweisen mit guten Noten in Englisch und Deutsch

  • Du bringst einen guten Teamgeist und Entscheidungsfreude mit

  • Du hast eine sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise

  • Du hast eine gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und eine Kunden- und Serviceorientierung

  • Du hast kaufmännisches Denken und Verhandlungsgeschick (z.B. bei der Kalkulation von Kosten für Eigen- und Fremdleistungen, bei Vertragsverhandlungen)

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Nabburg und Umgebung und bist berechtigt in Deutschland zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

 

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Starte deine Ausbildung in einem Team, das dich unterstützt und dir richtig gute Extras bietet:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 28 Tage Urlaub und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Nach den ersten Monaten nach Absprache ein Tag pro Woche von zuhause möglich

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Individuelle Förderung, praxisnahes Lernen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Youngster Days zum Kennenlernen, ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Abläufe machen dir den Einstieg leicht

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Ausbildungsgehalt, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

  • Zukunft bei der teccle group: Wir bilden aus mit dem Ziel, dich nach erfolgreichem Abschluss zu übernehmen

  

Bitte lade unbedingt Deine letzten beiden Zeugnisse, sowie Praktikumsnachweise mit hoch. Ohne diese können wir leider nur schwer eine Auswahl treffen.

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (m/f/d)
description:
Your new team:

Would you like to build Salesforce solutions that directly improve the experience of thousands of customers? At auxmoney, you will join a dynamic, cross functional team with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and a 360 degree view of the customer journey. You will work at the intersection of tech, product, and business, shaping scalable platform capabilities and reliable workflows that support one of Europe’s leading fintech platforms.


What you can expect:

  • Own end to end delivery: You architect, implement, and maintain high quality Salesforce solutions across Apex, Flows, LWC, and data models, and you take technical ownership from design to release.
  • Build strong architectures: You apply clean architecture, testability, and performance best practices, and you raise the bar for maintainable code across the platform.
  • Deliver great Salesforce UX: You design and optimize Lightning Web Components with strong performance, thoughtful interaction patterns, and a focus on usable, scalable experiences.
  • Secure by design: You implement robust security and sharing concepts aligned with Salesforce’s security model, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field level security.
  • Integrate with confidence: You design and implement integrations via REST and SOAP, platform events, and connectors with resilient patterns, strong authentication, and thorough error handling.
  • Optimize for scale: You build within Salesforce governor limits and enforce best practices for bulkification, caching, transaction management, and async processing.
  • Raise engineering standards: You define and champion platform standards, coding conventions, code reviews, and design guidelines as a trusted technical authority.
  • Mentor and multiply impact: You coach junior and mid level developers through pair programming, structured knowledge sharing, and pragmatic guidance that improves team output.
  • Partner across stakeholders: You collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Operations to translate complex business needs into scalable technical designs and delivery plans.
  • Test for trust: You set expectations for meaningful unit and integration testing, and you help the team maintain strong, reliable coverage that supports safe delivery.
  • Keep the platform reliable: You strengthen observability and maintainability through documentation, architectural decision records, and practical knowledge sharing.
  • Work setup: You will work remotely within Germany, with collaboration routines that keep delivery fast, aligned, and transparent.


Your profile

  • Seasoned Salesforce development: You bring extensive hands on Salesforce development experience (8+ years) in enterprise environments and a track record of delivering impact at scale.
  • Technical leadership: You are advanced in Flows and highly proficient in Apex and OOP, and you confidently choose the right approach across Flow, Apex, and configuration.
  • Strong LWC expertise: You have deep experience with Lightning Web Components, including lifecycle, reactivity, performance optimization, and UI and UX best practices.
  • Security and compliance mindset: You understand Salesforce’s security and sharing model and design for least privilege from the start.
  • Integration skills: You connect Salesforce to external systems via REST and SOAP, OAuth, and named or external credentials, and you select suitable integration patterns for complex scenarios.
  • Built for scale: You consistently apply best practices in governor limits, bulkification, transactions, async processing, and error handling, and you help others do the same.
  • Delivery discipline: You work fluently with Git and pull requests, and you have hands on experience with CI and CD for Salesforce, for example Salesforce DX and GitHub Actions.
  • Clear communication: You communicate technical concepts clearly in English and collaborate effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Nice to have: You bring German skills, Salesforce certifications such as PD I or PD II, Architect track progress, and experience with managed packages, platform events, and Data Loader or ETL.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
  • Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
  • Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
  • Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
  • Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
  • Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
  • Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.
Your perspective: You will shape how auxmoney builds and scales its Salesforce platform by owning end to end delivery and influencing technical standards. Your work will directly improve reliability, speed, and quality across customer facing and operational processes. You will grow your impact through mentoring and by helping define future architecture decisions.

At auxmoney, we’re committed to equal opportunity and diversity. We especially welcome applications from parents, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQIA+ community. title: Payment Operations Lead
description:
Payment Operations Lead

Global expansion is broken. Without a local company, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we become liable for a merchant's taxes. Sometimes we become the legal reseller in each market and carry the payments, tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We go live wherever a merchant needs to sell next, for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack - payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for a Payment Operations hire to own the part of Outpost where the money actually moves.

When we become the legal reseller in a market, we take the payment. Every merchant we onboard gets its own merchant ID and its own merchant category code, never pooled into one shared code, which is exactly why our approval rates beat the alternatives. Keeping that true across every market, every processor and every merchant is the job.

This is a quantitative role in an operational seat. You'll live in the transaction data: why authorisation rates differ by market, issuer, card type and hour of day, what a routing change is actually worth, where a 40 basis point cost difference is hiding, which decline codes are recoverable and which are noise. Then you'll act on it, with processors, with engineering, and with merchants.

You won't be siloed. Payments at Outpost touches pricing, treasury, tax and the product roadmap, and you'll be pulled into all of it. But your edge is the numbers, and we want someone whose first instinct on any problem is to pull the data and model it.

You'll work directly with the founding team and with engineering, who will build what you spec.

🧗 What You'll Get

Yes, the work is intense. But in return you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10 to 20 years to access.

You'll own economics that decide whether the company is profitable, negotiate with processors and banks as a principal rather than a customer, and get to see the full machinery of cross-border payments from the inside. We won't handhold, but we'll coach you hard.

🧩 What You'll Do

Build the system

  • Run payment operations agentically. Build agentic system that monitor approval rates, triage declines, assemble dispute evidence, chase reconciliation breaks and draft the processor follow-up, so humans only touch the exceptions. You'll design the workflows, set the guardrails, and audit what the agents produce

  • Write the playbooks: new processor onboarding, new market launch, incident response, dispute handling

  • Onboard new processors, banking partners and local acquiring as we launch new markets

Own payments performance

  • Own approval rates by market, processor, issuer, card type and merchant, and know why each one moves

  • Build and run routing logic. Decide what goes where, prove the uplift, and iterate

  • Run decline recovery: retry logic, network tokens, account updater, 3DS strategy and exemption handling

  • Run chargeback operations and fraud strategy. Set thresholds, represent disputes, keep merchants inside scheme limits

  • Own the payment incident path. When authorisations drop in one market at, you're the one who spots it and fixes it

Own the economics

  • Build full visibility into cost per transaction: scheme fees, interchange, processor margin, FX, and where each one leaks

  • Own processor relationships day to day. Performance reviews, pricing negotiations, new partner evaluation

  • Model the trade-off between approval rate and cost by market, and make the call

  • Feed real payment economics into how we price merchants

Own the money movement

  • Settlement, reconciliation and payouts. Every penny accounted for, every break chased down

  • Reserve logic and settlement timing by merchant segment and risk profile

  • Work with treasury on funding, FX exposure and cash timing across our local companies

💥 Example Projects

  • Take a market from a 66% approval rate to 90% or better, and prove exactly which changes did it

  • Build the routing framework that optimises approval rate against cost, market by market

  • Renegotiate processor pricing using our own volume and performance data

  • Build the cost-per-transaction model across every processor and market, and find the basis points nobody is watching

  • Debug delays in settlement and fix them across engineering, operations and the processor

  • Design reserve and settlement logic for a new merchant segment and implement it

  • Cut chargeback rate through better fraud tooling and merchant policy

  • Evaluate and onboard a new processor for local acquiring in Latin America or Asia

  • Build the payments monitoring layer so anomalies find us, not the other way round

🧱 What We're Looking For

title: Kundenservice & Community Manager:in (m/w/d) - Teilzeit, Werkstudent:in oder Minijob · Start: ab sofort · Office oder Hybrid, Remote möglich
description:
Naschen klingt für viele nach schlechtem Gewissen. Bei uns nicht. NaschNatur macht Schokolade, Riegel und Aufstriche, die ausschließlich mit Datteln gesüßt sind statt mit Industriezucker oder anderen Süßungsmitteln – bio, vegan, ohne Zusatzstoffe, mit Zutaten, die man aussprechen kann.

Ob das funktioniert, sagen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden besser als jede Anzeige: 4,94 von 5 Sternen bei über 3.500 Bewertungen. Und auffällig oft geht es in diesen Bewertungen gar nicht ums Produkt, sondern um den Service. Dazu kommen die Nachrichten — seitenlang, mit Fragen zur Umstellung, mit Erfolgsgeschichten, manchmal mit Ärger über ein Paket, das zu spät kam.

Genau da setzt diese Rolle an. Jede dieser Nachrichten ist ein Moment, in dem wir jemanden für gesunden Genuss begeistern können — auch die, die mit Ärger anfängt. Wir wollen, dass am Ende jedes Gesprächs ein erledigtes Anliegen steht und ein Mensch, der gern wiederkommt — nicht eine höfliche Antwort ohne Lösung. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme von NaschNatur gegenüber unseren Kundinnen und unserer Community. Du beantwortest Anfragen per Mail, Telefon und Social Media, betreust unsere Brand-Kanäle und sorgst dafür, dass jedes Anliegen erledigt wird — zugunsten der Kundin, nicht nur beantwortet. Deine Nordstern-Metriken: Lösungszeit und Kundenzufriedenheit.

Ausgangslage

Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein Kundenservice-Team. Der Service hängt aktuell an einer Person, die ihn neben Auftragsbearbeitung und Verwaltung mitmacht.

Das heißt für dich: Du wirst eingearbeitet, aber du bist nach wenigen Wochen die Person, die den Posteingang verantwortet. Und du verantwortest mehr als das Beantworten - du entwickelst unseren Kundenservice weiter: Prozesse, Antwortstandards, unser internes Wiki und das Help Center. Wer eine Frage zum fünften Mal beantwortet, ohne sich zu fragen warum, ist in dieser Rolle falsch.

Aufgaben

  • Du beantwortest Kundenanfragen per Mail, Telefon und Social Media in unserem Ticketing-System - mit klarer Priorität: lieferkritische Anliegen zuerst, immer, besonders montagfrüh
  • Du entscheidest Kulanz selbst bis zu einem festgelegten Betrag. Wir suchen die beste Lösung für die Kundin, nicht die günstigste für uns - und du setzt das um, ohne für jede Erstattung zu fragen
  • Du betreust unsere Community auf unseren Brand-Kanälen (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest): Kommentare und Nachrichten, nach unseren Tonalitäts-Guidelines. Sensible oder markenkritische Themen gibst du ans Brand-Team weiter - du musst nicht alles allein entscheiden
  • Du holst systematisch Kundenbewertungen ein, pflegst sie und gibst die stärksten Kundenstimmen ans Team weiter - unser Social Proof ist unser wichtigstes Verkaufsargument
  • Du entwickelst unseren Kundenservice weiter, statt ihn nur zu betreiben: Du dokumentierst Abläufe, Antwortstandards und Sonderfälle in unserem internen Wiki, hältst es aktuell und verbesserst Prozesse dort, wo sie haken. Was heute nur in deinem Kopf ist, steht morgen so im Wiki, dass eine Vertretung damit arbeiten kann
  • Du baust unser Help Center aus: Jede Frage, die häufiger als fünfmal pro Woche kommt, bekommt einen Artikel - geschrieben von dir, weil du sie selbst beantwortest
  • Du trainierst unsere KI-Antwortvorschläge im Ticketing-System und treibst damit, wie viele Anfragen sich ohne uns lösen
  • Du meldest Ursachen, nicht nur Symptome: Wenn eine Frage immer wiederkommt, liegt das oft am Shop, an einer Mail oder an einem Prozess - und diese Hinweise gehen direkt an die Leute, die das ändern können

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift - du schreibst freundlich, klar und ohne Floskeln
  • Echte Freundlichkeit, auch bei der fünften Nachfrage zur selben Sendung. Du kannst dich in andere hineinversetzen und behandelst jede Anfrage so, wie du selbst behandelt werden möchtest
  • Verlässlichkeit: Wenn du eine Antwort zusagst, kommt sie. Am Ende deines Arbeitstages bleibt kein Fall liegen
  • Offenheit für KI-Werkzeuge - wir arbeiten intensiv damit, und du trainierst unsere Antwort-KI mit
  • Für die Einarbeitung arbeitest du in den ersten zwei Wochen bei uns im Büro in Regensburg. Danach entscheidest du, ob du im Office, hybrid oder remote arbeitest - feste Zeiten pro Woche legen wir gemeinsam fest, Montagmorgen gehört dazu

Extra-Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung im Kundenservice, im Einzelhandel oder in der Gastronomie - überall dort, wo du täglich mit Menschen zu tun hattest
  • Erfahrung mit einem Ticket-System oder mit den Social-Media-Kanälen eines Unternehmens
  • Du schreibst gern und dokumentierst sauber: Wer eine Antwort so formulieren kann, dass sie danach als Wiki- oder Help-Center-Artikel taugt, spart uns dieselbe Antwort hundertmal
  • Interesse an Ernährung, gesundem Genuss oder E-Commerce - oder einfach Lust, unsere Produkte kennenzulernen

Benefits

  • Das Anstellungsmodell richtet sich nach dir: Teilzeit, Werkstudentenstelle oder Minijob. Was davon zu dir passt und wie viele Stunden es werden, klären wir im ersten Gespräch
  • Echten Handlungsspielraum statt Skript: Du entscheidest Kulanz selbst und setzt unsere Geld-zurück-Garantie um
  • Klare Ziele statt Micromanagement: zwei Kennzahlen, wöchentlicher Rhythmus, viel Gestaltungsfreiheit. Die Zielwerte kalibrieren wir in deinen ersten Wochen gemeinsam an echten Daten
  • Eine Rolle, die mehr ist als Abarbeiten: Du siehst die Muster hinter den Anfragen - und darfst dafür sorgen, dass sie verschwinden
  • Eine Marke mit einer Stimme, die es schon gibt: Du musst keine Tonalität erfinden, es gibt Guidelines, an denen du dich orientierst

As a Senior Product Designer, you will be responsible for translating highly technical and complex problems into clean and understandable solutions. You will be the voice of user experience and design standards in a cross-functional setting, and responsible for the end-to-end design process for your team. title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. 

 

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

Role:

We are looking for an experienced LLM Engineer for our new Berlin AI lab who is passionate about agentic AI - systems where models reason, act, and learn autonomously. You should have a proven track record of building scalable, production-grade AI systems and a strong grasp of how to translate cutting-edge research into real-world impact. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with creativity and a bias for shipping practical, elegant solutions.

Your role sits at the intersection of our data and backend teams. You will design and implement advanced, (multi-)agentic AI systems that apply LLMs not just as tools, but as autonomous collaborators - reasoning over data, orchestrating workflows, and driving decisions. You’ll combine solid backend engineering with a deep understanding of how LLMs can act, learn, and adapt to solve complex user problems at scale.

This role is perfect for someone who loves turning cutting-edge AI and NLP research into scalable systems, thrives on end-to-end ownership and autonomy, an experimentation-welcoming setting, and wants to shape how agentic AI transforms enterprise software.

You will be working closely with the Head of Agentic AI Engineering and our compact high-performance team of LLM engineers, software engineers, and data scientists. The team is part of recently acquired Berlin startup Kodex AI and works hybrid from an amazing office (great location, gym, rooftop pool & sauna, many events), and from home.

Our evolving tech stack:

  • Core: python (fastAPI, langchain), Typescript (React)

  • Infra & storage: MySQL, Pinecone, GCP, AWS, Azure, Firebase, Docker, github

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in software or LLM engineering, ideally with Python

  • Strong foundation in backend or data systems, and experience deploying LLM-based applications to production

  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenDevin, or custom agentic architectures)

  • Understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-use / agent frameworks, LLM evaluation, NLP methods

  • Experience with most of our tech stack (as listed above)

  • Bonus: experience building B2B SaaS or AI workflow products

  • Bonus: experience in an early-stage startup environment

  • Bonus: experience in FinTech / RegTech / Finance / Regulatory / Compliance domains

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Customer Success Manager

🌍 About us

Plinth is a fast-growing tech startup working with charities, foundations and local government. Small and local charities are highly effective but largely hidden. They have no spare time and no spare money. We're building the tools these organisations need and shining a light on the work they do. Read more on our blog.

🚀We're growing fast. 3-4x this year. We get 7+ new clients a month and we're shipping new features every few days. This means things move quickly and your work directly shapes how we scale. You'll have real responsibility from day one.

❤️It's really impactful work. Our clients are charities and grassroots organisations across the UK, and soon internationally. When you help them succeed with our platform, you're directly amplifying their impact. Every successful onboarding means a charity spends less time fighting with their systems and more time on their actual mission.

🤝You'll work with impressive people. Our team is talented, collaborative and slightly strange(?). We value impact, speed and openness. We work in person in our office in Old Street because we genuinely enjoy each other's company (most of the time). It’s a high trust, creative space where if you think something's a good idea, you just go do it.

💼 You need to be able to:

  • Work both fast and slow: You'll navigate slow public sector procurement cycles one minute, then help us ship a new feature over lunch the next. The whiplash is intense but it keeps things interesting.

  • Keep it real: You'll be getting the train to community centres and youth clubs where the heating doesn't work and where the paint is peeling off the walls. It’s rarely glamourous. You need to be willing to meet clients where they are, literally and figuratively.

  • Listen to problems, ignore solutions: Clients will tell you exactly what they think they need. Your job is to understand the actual problem and guide them to what will really work, even when they're convinced they already know the answer. This requires self-confidence, understanding of the platform and genuine listening in equal measure.

  • Teach people: Most of our clients don't love shiny gadgets. If you're the kind of person who enjoys teaching your gran to use a smartphone, this is ideal. You need to explain some fairly complex systems clearly without being condescending and still getting user adoption

  • Automate and document yourself away:🤖 We're small and growing fast. Build systems and processes that make your job increasingly redundant. There’s always plenty more to do.

  • Understand the difference between "urgent" and 🚨 URGENT — When you're managing 4-8 concurrent client projects and everyone thinks their issue is critical, you need to distinguish between what must happen for launch versus what can wait. This is harder than it sounds.

  • Grow with the role: we need someone who is comfortable with our clients and team doubling every 6 months. Your role will rapidly change to reflect that, but it leaves you with lots of room to grow in responsibility.

🧩 What kind of background do we think would be a good fit?

We’d expect a few years experience in something like the following:

  • Coaching / Tutoring: You know how to meet people where they are and guide them to better outcomes

  • Hospitality management: Service mindset, de-escalation skills, managing expectations when things don't go to plan, letting the customer think they’re right when they aren’t

  • Event/production management: Used to juggling moving pieces, keeping stakeholders calm, making last-minute pivots when things go wrong

  • Community organising/activism: Already comfortable in the spaces you'll be visiting, get the mission, used to working with limited resources

  • Consulting: You're used to parachuting into chaos, extracting actionable tasks, and keeping multiple clients calm simultaneously

  • User research/UX: Good at understanding what people actually need versus what they say they need, synthesising feedback into actionable insights

  • Knowledge of the charity sector is a significant advantage, whether that’s as an employee, consultant or as a long term volunteer.

  • It would also definitely be helpful if you have any technical experience to help with managing data migrations.

Importantly, This is a list of suggestions.

If you have experience in only some of this, or have only some of these skills, please do apply anyway.

📈 How can you measure your success?

  • Speed of getting customers successfully using Plinth: From signed contract to actively using the platform and seeing value.

  • Positive recommendations: Clients recommending us positively to their networks — it’s a big source of our growth.

  • Increasing use of Plinth: Clients expanding how they use the platform over time, not just maintaining baseline usage

🧠 The role

Client Onboarding (70%) — Lead onboarding from kick-off to go-live. Break down complex projects into clear phases. Manage timelines, priorities, and expectations across 7+ new clients per month. Stay on top of new features we ship every few days. Push back when needed and teach anyone regardless of background.

Operations & Process Improvement (30%) — Audit and optimise our support systems (expect to manage Intercom chat a couple of days a week). Refine onboarding workflows. Keep documentation current. Work with engineering to communicate what's urgent versus what's just a problem. Track feature requests across clients and synthesise them into product improvements.

  • Equity as part of your package

description:
JOB SUMMARY

More in Common is looking for a Chief of Staff.  This is a new role and a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide.
(Please note that the preferred London location is for ease of communication with Tim Dixon, who is based in the UK. The postholder will not be involved in the day-to-day polling and research activities of More in Common UK, and will not report or routinely provide support to our Executive Director in the UK, Luke Tryl.)


ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

More in Common is a nonprofit dedicated to understanding the dynamics of polarisation, and identifying solutions that can strengthen social cohesion and confidence in democracy. We help leaders navigate the dynamics of polarisation more effectively, find common ground and bring people together to address shared challenges. More in Common's work is frequently featured in media and used by leaders in government, nonprofits, philanthropy, education, the arts and business. 
 
We have a country-led model, with work deeply rooted in national contexts and led by country directors in each of our seven countries, with a total headcount approaching 100. Our teams generate research insights, translate them into thought leadership, and disseminate and implement them across a wide ecosystem of partners and stakeholders. We hold relationships with leaders in many sectors of society, across politics, media, business, civil society, philanthropy, culture and faith, and from national leaders to local community groups. Recent work has produced fresh insights into public attitudes on immigration, online safety, nature and the energy transition, Ukraine, and democracy.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. 
 
The Chief of Staff is a new role, created as More in Common transitions from its founding phase, when the organisation was led by its co-founders, to sole CEO leadership. It incorporates a senior adviser role, in which the Chief of Staff will be the principal aide, advisor and coordinator to the global CEO Tim Dixon, ensuring priorities advance, decisions move efficiently and commitments are executed. The Chief of Staff will also act as organisational glue: working closely with More in Common’s team of country leaders and directors, ensuring alignment between country executive directors, the global team and the CEO around More in Common's strategy, programmes and operations, and helping spot and resolve problems before they escalate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy

  • Strategic counsel: Trusted thought partner to the CEO on strategy and major decisions, drawing on visibility across the whole organisation and ensuring alignment within its country-led model. 
  • CEO communications: Shapes the CEO’s internal and external communications, and absorbs the coordination, communication, and follow-through work that would otherwise pull the CEO away from key public-facing responsibilities.
 
Organisational coordination
  • CEO workflow: Manages the CEO's priorities, time and decision pipeline with the Senior Executive Coordinator, so the right issues get attention and decisions don't stall. 
  • Team alignment and delivery: Keeps global and country teams aligned on shared priorities, facilitates decision-making across the organisation, and leads special projects requiring senior-level attention.
 
Leadership 
  • Country ED support: Liaises with country Executive Directors on the CEO's behalf, identifying where teams need more support and providing assistance in crises. 
  • Talent and succession: Supports leadership succession planning and mentors emerging leaders across country teams.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Commitment to More in Common’s mission and values.
  • Experience working closely with, or in direct support of, a senior executive, founder or CEO.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and time-sensitive decisions simultaneously. 
  • Sound judgement and discretion, including experience handling sensitive or confidential matters. 
  • Comfortable operating with incomplete information, and confident making calls on when to resolve issues independently versus escalate. 
  • The ability to lead through influence rather than authority, working effectively with peers and country teams who have their own mandates and priorities.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information for diverse audiences.
  • Inter-disciplinary interests and experience, such as having worked in different sectors (business, government, nonprofit), countries and roles. 
  • Fluency in English and at least one of French, German, Spanish, Polish or Portuguese languages.
  • At least six years’ working experience in such fields as public opinion research, public policy, political science, and international relations.


OTHER INFORMATION

More in Common intentionally invests time, energy, and resources in nurturing a distinctive values-driven culture. This culture defines how we work together as a team and with others:

  • Humble, ambitious and generous
  • Rigour and excellence in everything we do
  • Driven by the common good, not by ideology or partisanship
  • Deep curiosity about people, and a commitment to elevating others’ views, particularly those whose voices are largely unheard
  • Firmly rooted in each of our national contexts but curious about the world beyond
  • Valuing diversity of thought, allowing our own beliefs to be challenged and embracing healthy disagreement
  • Embracing a dual role as both sense-makers and change-makers
  • Valuing courage and risk-taking
  • Embracing learning and innovation, and always looking for new paths to make a difference
  • Engaging others from a starting point of trust
  • Drawing from a wide range of backgrounds, worldviews, identities and life experiences
  • Believing in the power of a good laugh and being a great place to work.


COMPENSATION AND CONDITIONS

  • Competitive salary related to location, and excellent benefits along with generous leave and family policy 
  • Some regular international travel
  • Personal learning budget
  • Working in one of our country offices, with a preference for London as our CEO is most often there


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We believe our impact can be greater if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political persuasions and life experiences. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The deadline to apply is August 31, 2026. Interested candidates should include a CV and a cover letter explaining your personal reasons for wanting to work at More in Common, in this role. A strong cover letter reflects the kind of attention we try to bring to our work - original, insightful and personalised. We want to hear something that only you could tell us, without AI assistance.

This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

  • Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.
  • An advertising technology expert. You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.

  • Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth

We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning.
