title: Senior Go Developer (f/m/d) – Focus on gRPC & Enterprise Applications
description:
You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

Your Responsibilities :

  • Design and build the gRPC services at the heart of the Cloud Portal, APIs that other teams depend on and that must stay compatible as the platform grows

  • Take services end to end: design, ship, and run them in production, across both cloud and on-prem

  • Solve the performance and scaling problems that come with multi-tenant systems and large datasets

  • Help shape architecture and technical direction, where your input genuinely moves things in a team this small


  • 5+ years writing production-grade Go

  • Strong grasp of idiomatic Go, concurrency patterns, and profiling with pprof, plus a real understanding of escape analysis, allocation behavior, and what the GC is actually doing

  • Solid experience building and maintaining APIs using gRPC, including Protobuf versioning, streaming, and API lifecycle best practices (bonus: you know Google AIPs)

  • Proven experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), performance tuning, and schema design

We are a small engineering team inside Natuvion that finds and builds the next high-value additions to Natuvion's

product portfolio. We build DCS Compose, a modern language for enterprise data transformations with deep integration

into the Natuvion Cloud.

Our work has three main aspects

  • Understanding the domain. We make Natuvion's transformation knowledge searchable, structured, and available to AI agents. Hundreds of customer projects have produced millions of lines of transformation content. We build the infrastructure that turns this accumulated knowledge into a usable asset.

  • User focused development. We understand our users and develop tools and applications for them. Our mission is to help our users excel at their work by providing them with the technical means to do so.

  • Technical ownership. We develop solutions with deep integration into Natuvion's cloud landscape. We develop the backend and frontend functionality keeping in mind performance, adaptability and correctness.

We build on top of the Natuvion Cloud, using its APIs and shared components as our foundation.

The cloud team scales the platform; we focus on what to build on it.

The team has strong technical and scientific backgrounds. We care about quality even in prototypes: Disciplined engineering, not vibe-coding.

We're part of Natuvion (~500 employees, SAP Gold Partner). That means access to enterprise customers, real

transformation projects, and corporate backing, with the autonomy of a small team.

Why Join Us

  • Real problems, not toy projects. Enterprise data transformations involve millions of records, complex business rules, and tight timelines. The prototypes you build here solve real problems for real customers.

  • End-to-end ownership. From observing a process in a customer project to shipping a working prototype. You decide what to build and how.

  • AI as a daily tool, not a buzzword. We use agentic coding and AI-assisted development and help the organization

    with AI usage.

  • Small team, big reach. A few people with direct access to enterprise customers like BMW, Volkswagen, E.ON and Lufthansa, a cloud platform to build on, and the freedom to move fast.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build features for the DCS Compose application on top of the Natuvion Cloud: frontend, backend, and API integrations.

  • Develop UI components for the content corpus: search interfaces, data visualization, and comparison tools.

  • Integrate AI capabilities into applications: MCP, semantic search, and embeddings.

  • Use and extend NCP's shared frontend components and APIs as building blocks for new solutions.

  • Maintain quality standards: testing, code review, and clean architecture — even when moving fast.


Your Profile

  • Strong frontend and backend skills. You're comfortable building both sides of a web application.

  • Experience with API design and consuming platform APIs.

  • Familiarity with modern TypeScript, React (preferrably NextJS) and Golang.

  • Knowledge in Protobuf and gRPC is a plus.

  • An eye for good UI. You build interfaces people actually want to use.

  • Quality discipline. You write tests, you review code, and you care about maintainability.

How We Work

  • Prototyping with standards. We ship fast, but not at all costs. Prototypes have tests, clean APIs, and documentation.

    When a prototype proves its value, it should be ready to hand off and not rewritten from scratch.

  • Our current stack: Golang, gRPC, TypeScript, NextJS. We build on Natuvion Cloud's APIs and shared frontend components.

  • The stack evolves as the problems do. We pick the right tool, not the familiar one.

  • Agentic coding as a discipline. We use AI-assisted development tools daily. We hold the same quality standards whether code was written by a human or an agent.

What you can expect from us

An environment that is always open to change and optimization. There is no "it's always been like this" with us. You have the opportunity to contribute your knowledge, design processes, standardize existing topics or optimize workflows. Be a source of inspiration and bring us even further forward with your expertise!

We create conditions in which you feel comfortable

  • Home office contracts & absolute flexibility through free organization of working hours

  • Permanent position and 30 days of vacation

  • FlexWork: Work remotely from other European countries for up to 3 months per year

  • Monthly budget for individually selectable benefits from over 50 possible offers via emplu, various offers via corporate benefits, as well as bicycle and car leasing via salary conversion

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 free sessions with psychologists annually as well as access to meditations and courses

  • We provide you with targeted support in your professional and personal development at Natuvion

  • Mentoring program for a structured and personal induction

  • Be part of the #teamgreen - At Natuvion, you'll work on innovative projects as part of a team that stands up for each other. We rely on cooperation, openness and trust

  • Modern equipment and central offices in Walldorf, Berlin, Munich and Leipzig

  • Your long-term perspective is important to us, which is why we subsidize your company pension scheme as well as capital-forming benefits


About Natuvion

Natuvion builds software and provides consulting for enterprise data transformations — migrations, restructurings,
carve-outs, and system retirements, primarily in the SAP ecosystem. Founded in 2014 in Walldorf, Germany, the company
employs around 500 people across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the United States, Slovakia, and Australia. Natuvion has
been part of NTT DATA Business Solutions since 2022.

Natuvion holds SAP Gold Partner status. Customers include BMW, Volkswagen, E.ON, Vattenfall, Carlsberg, Lufthansa, BASF,
and Lidl.

title: Working Student IT Operations (m/f/d)
description:
Hi!

We are Coffee Circle, Germany’s leading sustainable specialty coffee roastery based in Berlin. We offer the world’s finest coffee and equipment to over 150,000 customers online and in our Cafés, driven by our goal to make high-end coffee experiences enjoyable and accessible to all. We foster direct trade relationships with coffee farmers worldwide, pay high prices for the coffee beans, and ensure everyone involved in the value chain gets treated fairly and respectfully. For every kilogram of coffee we sell, we invest € 1 through our Coffee Circle Foundation e.V. to help support sustainable improvements in coffee-growing areas, such as providing clean drinking water, hygiene training, and coffee labs. With over 5 million euros raised in donations, we cannot wait to increase our positive impact with you on our team, one cup of coffee at a time.

Your role

  • Support the IT setup across our cafés, office, and warehouse, from POS systems and printers to tablets, routers, and Raspberry Pis.
  • Keep our UniFi networks and internet connections running and help troubleshoot issues remotely or on-site.
  • Maintain and provision devices, keep our hardware inventory clean, and support onboarding and offboarding.
  • Document setups, fixes, and processes in Notion so knowledge stays accessible.
  • Support practical GDPR and information security topics, including TOMs, deletion concepts, access management, and security documentation.
  • Report to our CTO and be part of our Tech Team.

Your profile
  • You’re currently enrolled at university, ideally in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related field.
  • You have a basic understanding of networks and Linux and enjoy learning new technical topics.
  • You work independently, stay organized, and appreciate good documentation.
  • You have experience with UniFi, GDPR or ISO 27001 is a plus, not a must.
  • You’re happy to travel between our Berlin locations when needed. Being based in Berlin and working mainly onsite is non-negotiable for this role.
  • You are available 20 hours a week, 3 days a week. Based on your availability, you can choose the days you work (Monday to Saturday).
  • You’re fluent in English; German is a plus.

And this is what you will get from us
  • Flexible working hours. Our core working hours are from 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM, but of course we understand that Working Students have different needs.
  • Discounts on our coffee and accessories, as well as access to online voucher platforms like Corporate Benefits and FutureBens.
  • Access to platforms for mental and physical health, such as nilohealth, and the possibility to have access to Urban Sports Club M membership after 1 year with us.  
  • The best coffee in the office and quarterly coffee vouchers to enjoy your favorite drink at home with your loved ones.
  • Regular All-Hands meetings, coffee training, and interdisciplinary team events.

What we believe in

We are a purpose-driven organization. For us, growth means increasing our social impact in coffee cooperatives around the world and opening a new world of coffee to our customers. We strongly believe in authenticity and compassion to build strong and innovative teams. We cultivate a humble and playful mindset to create an endless learning experience for our team.

No matter your ethnicity, skin color, descent, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity – if the job description fits you, we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Senior Brand Partnerships & Licensing Manager (All Genders)
description:

Our Brand Activation department is where we move from product to culture. We do that through limited editions: co-branded drops with entertainment IPs, licensing deals with cultural icons, collaborations that make people genuinely excited about what they are eating.

Are you a senior brand partnerships and licensing professional who closes deals, owns projects end-to-end, and has the network to make things happen from day one? If so, read on.


YOUR TASKS

  • Partner Identification & Pipeline Management: You proactively source, evaluate, and pitch licensing and co-branding opportunities across entertainment IPs, cultural icons, celebrities, and lifestyle brands. You run an active pipeline of 5-10 live opportunities at any given time and know which ones are worth pursuing for our brand and commercial goals.

  • Deal Negotiation & Contracting: You lead negotiations end-to-end and close with confidence. LOIs, licensing agreements, talent contracts, commercial terms, royalties, usage rights. You represent us in front of top-tier partners, agents, and IP holders and you get deals across the line.

  • End-to-End Project Management: You own the full lifecycle of every limited edition. Concept, LOI, product development, packaging redesign, legal sign-off, market launch. You keep cross-functional teams across brand, product, design, legal, sales, retail, and D2C moving in the same direction and on time.

  • Business Case & Performance Ownership: You build and own the business case for every collaboration: budget, margin, revenue forecast, and post-launch review. You track revenue contribution, retail sell-through, D2C performance, and brand awareness lift per edition, and use it to make the next one better.

  • Internal Alignment & Launch Enablement: You brief and align brand, social, ecom, and retail on launch strategy, content needs, and sell-in materials so every edition lands the way it should, in-store and online.

  • You bring 5+ years in licensing, brand partnerships, or co-branding, ideally within FMCG, consumer lifestyle, entertainment, or a licensing/talent agency.   • Track record managing both D2C and retail launches at the same time.
  • Degree in Marketing, Media & Communications Management, Business Administration, or similar, though your track record matters far more than the diploma.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose

If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The People & Talent team at Airwallex is dedicated to attracting, developing, and enabling the brightest and most ambitious minds to drive our company forward. We are a global, vibrant, and dynamic team focused on creating a positive, inclusive, and high-performing environment where our people can grow and do their best work.

 

Through thoughtful People & Talent programmes, scalable processes, and a deep understanding of our organisation’s needs, we build a collaborative and engaging employee experience that supports Airwallex’s continued growth and success.

 

What you’ll do

This role sits at the intersection of People Operations and Workplace Experience for our Paris/Berlin/Barcelona office. You will act as a critical “boots on the ground” partner, ensuring core HR operations for the EMEA team run smoothly while helping build a strong, engaging in-office culture during a period of rapid growth for EMEA.

 

You’ll own high-volume, detail-oriented work (onboarding, offboarding, payroll inputs, benefits) while also identifying opportunities to improve and automate processes as we scale. As part of the EMEA team, you will help with our build-out as well as opportunities to contribute to broader EMEA people operations work supporting the Region.

This is hybrid based in Berlin ( 4 days a week)

 

Responsibilities:

  • Own onboarding and offboarding end-to-end, ensuring a seamless employee experience

  • Serve as the primary POC for HR inquiries; manage ticketing system with timely, high-quality responses

  • Maintain accurate HRIS and payroll data (incl. EOR), run audits, and manage data changes

  • Support payroll processes, including commissions and bonuses by auditing inputs and resolving discrepancies

  • Administer benefits programs and support ongoing rollout; ensure compliance with the relevant regulations for the markets that you are supporting.

  • You will oversee day-to-day office operations (supplies, vendors, access, equipment, general upkeep)

  • Act as a front-of-house presence: greet visitors, manage deliveries, coordinate with building management

  • Support and execute employee engagement initiatives (events, monthly celebrations, quarterly offsites)

  • Help build and scale a strong in-office culture as the office grows

  • Identify inefficiencies in manual workflows and drive process documentation, improvements, automation and AI

  • Gather employee feedback (surveys, onboarding check-ins, day-to-day interactions) and translate it into action

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Foundational Generalist experience in People Operations / HR in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

  • Have a passion for culture and team building, you love bringing people together, and are excited to be a culture champion in a growing organization

  • Strong working knowledge of local HR practices, particularly benefits and compliance

  • Hands-on, detail-oriented operator who is comfortable owning admin-heavy workflows

  • Experience supporting payroll processes (incl. variable comp like commissions/bonuses)

  • Confident managing ambiguity and building processes from scratch

Preferred skills:

  • Proficiency with a startup tech stack – Slack, Zoom, Lattice, Atlassian (Jira/Confluence), Google suite

  • Familiarity with various HRIS, EOR, or payroll platforms (BambooHR, Deel, etc.)

  • Exposure to workplace experience/office operations in a hybrid environment

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Head of Social Media & Creative (m/w/d) Vollzeit | · Start: ab sofort · Office oder Hybrid, Remote möglich
description:
NaschNatur ist nicht durch klassische Werbung groß geworden.

Unsere Community ist entstanden, weil wir Social Media anders verstehen: persönlich statt werblich, relevant statt austauschbar und mit Content, den Menschen wirklich sehen, teilen und weiterschicken wollen.

Heute erreichen wir mit unserer Founder Brand rund um Andi mehrere hunderttausend Menschen – und Social Media ist einer unserer wichtigsten Wachstumskanäle.

Für die nächste Phase suchen wir deshalb keinen klassischen Social Media Manager.
Wir suchen jemanden, der Social Media wirklich versteht.

Jemanden, der nicht nur weiß, dass ein Reel eine gute Hook braucht, sondern erkennt, warum Menschen bei genau diesem Video stoppen – und beim nächsten weiterscrollen.
Der versteht, warum ein Format auf Instagram funktioniert und auf TikTok nicht.
Der Trends nicht einfach übernimmt, sondern einschätzen kann, welche Mechanik dahintersteckt und ob sie zu NaschNatur passt.
Und der aus einer starken Personal Brand gemeinsam mit einem bestehenden Content-Team eine noch stärkere Content Engine baut.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Social Media & Creative übernimmst du die inhaltliche und kreative Verantwortung für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle.
Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Andi die übergeordnete Contentstrategie und übersetzt ihre Gedanken, Geschichten, Produkte und Perspektiven in Content, der plattformnativ funktioniert.

Gleichzeitig führst du unser Content-Team und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer Idee nicht einfach irgendein Post entsteht, sondern richtig guter NaschNatur-Content.
Du bist die Person, bei der die kreativen Fäden zusammenlaufen.

Was du bei uns verantwortest

  • Du entwickelst unsere Social-Media- und Contentstrategie kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du verstehst Instagram und TikTok als unterschiedliche Plattformen und entwickelst Content entsprechend plattformnativ.
  • Du erkennst neue Formate, Mechaniken und Veränderungen auf den Plattformen früh und übersetzt sie für NaschNatur.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Andi starke Contentideen, Hooks, Storylines und Formate.
  • Du führst unser bestehendes Content-Team fachlich und organisatorisch.
  • Du briefst Creator, Video, Foto und Design so, dass aus einer Idee eine starke Umsetzung entsteht.
  • Du übernimmst die kreativen Korrekturschleifen und gibst konkretes, umsetzbares Feedback.
  • Du stellst sicher, dass Content vor Veröffentlichung unseren qualitativen Anspruch erfüllt.
  • Du analysierst unsere Performance nicht nur anhand von Zahlen, sondern leitest daraus ab, warum etwas funktioniert hat und was wir daraus für den nächsten Content lernen.
  • Du entwickelst erfolgreiche Formate weiter, statt ständig bei null anzufangen.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Learnings, Guidelines und Prozesse im Team ankommen und tatsächlich angewendet werden.
  • Du entwickelst das Content-Team fachlich weiter und hebst langfristig das kreative Niveau des gesamten Teams.

**Was du ausdrücklich nicht bist
**
Du bist nicht die Person, die einfach einen Redaktionsplan verwaltet.
Du bist auch nicht nur die Person, die Aufgaben verteilt und Meetings moderiert.
Und wir suchen niemanden, der Content nach einem festen Schema produziert und glaubt, dass „Hook + Mehrwert + CTA“ automatisch guten Social Content ergibt.
Wir suchen jemanden mit echtem Creative Judgment.
Du solltest dir Content ansehen und eine begründete Meinung dazu haben, warum er funktioniert oder nicht funktioniert.

Qualifikation

**Du passt zu uns, wenn …
**
… du Social Media nicht nur beruflich nutzt, sondern die Plattformen wirklich kennst und verstehst.
… du regelmäßig erkennst, warum bestimmte Videos, Hooks oder Formate funktionieren, bevor du die Insights gesehen hast.
… du ein sehr gutes Gespür für Sprache, Storytelling und Personal Brands hast.
… du zwischen „formal richtig“ und „das will ich wirklich anschauen“ unterscheiden kannst.
… du stark genug im Creative bist, um anderen Kreativen konstruktives Feedback zu geben.
… du Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernehmen möchtest und nicht nur für deine eigene To-do-Liste.
… du schnell lernst und Feedback nicht einfach umsetzt, sondern die Logik dahinter verstehst und beim nächsten Mal selbst anwenden kannst.
… du Lust auf ein Umfeld hast, in dem viel ausprobiert wird und sich Dinge schnell verändern.

**Was Erfolg in dieser Rolle für uns bedeutet
**
Unser Ziel ist nicht, einfach mehr Content zu produzieren.
Unser Ziel ist besserer Content mit größerem Impact.
Du bist erfolgreich, wenn unser Content-Team zunehmend selbstständig auf hohem Niveau arbeitet, erfolgreiche Formate schneller erkennt und weiterentwickelt und Andi nicht mehr jede Caption, jeden Cut und jede kreative Entscheidung selbst kontrollieren muss.
Andi bleibt Gesicht, Stimme und kreativer Ursprung der Founder Brand.
Du baust gemeinsam mit ihr das System und das Team, das daraus skalierbaren Content macht.

**Unser Anspruch
**
NaschNatur wächst schnell. Entsprechend suchen wir niemanden, der darauf wartet, dass ihm jemand sagt, was als Nächstes zu tun ist.
Wir suchen jemanden, der hinsieht, versteht, entscheidet und Verantwortung übernimmt.
Wenn du bei einem schlecht performenden Reel nicht zuerst denkst:
„Der Algorithmus mochte es wohl nicht.“
sondern:
„Okay. Warum haben Menschen hier nicht weitergeschaut – und was machen wir beim nächsten Mal anders?“
… dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Your mission is to design and maintain a scalable, asynchronous backend that powers OKAPI:Orbits' end-to-end solutions across mission design, Space Situational Awareness (SSA), Space Traffic Management (STM), Flight Dynamics (FD), and Space Traffic Coordination (STC), supporting satellite operators throughout their entire mission lifecycle.

Your tasks and responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain asynchronous, microservice-based backend systems, primarily in Python for external customer projects and in parallel in Java Spring Boot for our products
  • Implement and optimize data processing and distribution pipelines that handle large volumes of orbital, telemetry, and mission data
  • Design and maintain message-based communication structures between microservices (e.g., via RabbitMQ or comparable message brokers)

  • Plan and document implementation steps, from system architecture through deployment in a cloud-native environment
  • Ensure code quality, automated testing, and adherence to security and development standards
  • Advance CI/CD pipelines, observability, and automation to support stable, continuous releases
  • Analyze and resolve complex issues in distributed systems with a focus on efficiency and reliability
  • Work within small, interdisciplinary teams, contributing your backend expertise to cross-functional projects


Your profile

Must-haves

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or completed vocational training as a Fachinformatiker (IT specialist)
  • At least 2 years of professional experience with Python for backend development, scripting, automation, or data processing

  • Practical experience with testing and code quality assurance

  • Ability to independently plan, implement, and review complex features in close collaboration with engineers and scientists
  • Proactive communication, structured way of working, and good written and spoken English
Nice-to-haves
  • Experience with orchestration, particularly Kubernetes
  • Experience with code reviews and adherence to coding standards
  • Solid understanding of software architecture principles, including modular structure, scalability, and maintainability
  • Experience with secure software development
  • Background in or interest in the space or aerospace sector

title: Senior Platform Engineer, Event Streaming Platform (Kafka)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join Event Streaming team — the distributed team responsible for the Kafka infrastructure and event streaming systems that power business-critical workflows across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash.

You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of Platform Engineering and Reliability Engineering, building and running the streaming backbone that is used by thousands of services across 3 companies. This is deeply technical work: you'll own distributed systems at scale, contribute to long-term architecture decisions, and be working on the reliability of critical parts of infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, in-house Event Streaming abstraction (internally called Event Bus) and any future streaming platform technologies. These systems support critical workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale, event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.
  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, Event Bus and related streaming components.
  • Debug complex distributed systems issues — latency issues, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, partition imbalances — and drive them to resolution.
  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.
  • Contribute to the team's 24/7 On-call rotation and incident response, and drive continuous improvement through pre-mortems, operational readiness checklists and post-mortem action items.
  • Partner closely with other teams within Storage organization and wider Core Infrastructure org, like SRE, Data Platform, and Caching teams across EU and US regions — including occasional collaboration in the EU evening hours. 
  • Shape the long-term architecture and evolution of our event streaming platform, contributing to RFCs and technical strategy.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.
  • Deep experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.
  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar — with the emphasis on building reliable, production-grade systems and libraries.
  • Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.
  • Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.
  • Strong communication and writing skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.
  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.
  • Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.
  • Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Product Designer
description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Product Designer to join our Education team in Berlin. In this individual contributor role, you will help shape learning experiences that support medical students and professionals as they prepare for career-defining exams and continue learning throughout their careers.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this role be exciting for you?

You will shape the end-to-end exam preparation experience, with a focus on our Qbank product. Your work will help medical learners globally, to practice more effectively, close knowledge gaps, simulate real exam conditions, and benefit from personalized, AI-powered learning experiences, directly supporting AMBOSS's mission to empower healthcare professionals.

Working in a cross-functional team with Product, Engineering, Medical, User Research, and Design, you'll turn user needs into intuitive, practical solutions, validate them with users and data, and bring them to life.

This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys simplifying complex workflows, is passionate about educational and medical UX, and is excited to explore how AI can enhance both learning and the design process. You will report to the Director of UX Design.


You will:

  • Design and improve the end-to-end exam preparation experience for medical students and professionals in Germany, the United States, and international and adjacent healthcare markets across desktop and mobile.

  • Work as part of the Qbank Experience Team, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Medical, Research, and Design to understand user needs and turn them into thoughtful product experiences.

  • Take ownership of assigned design problems and projects, from understanding the problem and exploring concepts through prototyping, validation, detailed design, and implementation.

  • Design and prototype learning experiences that help users practice effectively, reinforce knowledge, and prepare confidently for professional exams.

  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to inform your design decisions, working with our in-house User Research and Data teams to understand user behavior, validate solutions, and iterate on your designs.

  • Collaborate with medical experts and editors to understand the needs of our highly knowledgeable users and translate complex medical and educational requirements into simple, intuitive experiences.

  • Work closely with engineers throughout the design and implementation process to ensure that shipped experiences reflect the design intent while taking technical opportunities and constraints into account.

  • Collaborate with other product teams to help create a cohesive and personalized user experience across relevant parts of AMBOSS, such as sign-up, dashboard, shop, and user profile.

  • Apply and advocate for strong design principles, usability, and accessibility, contributing to high-quality and consistent experiences across AMBOSS.

  • Contribute to the wider AMBOSS Design community through design critiques, knowledge sharing, and contributions to our design system, interaction patterns, and other shared design topics.

  • Build a deep understanding of our users and advocate for their needs throughout the product development process.

You bring:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in UX or product design, with strong skills in information architecture and communicating complex information clearly and concisely.

  • Strong user-centered design skills, attention to detail, and a solid understanding of UX and visual design fundamentals.

  • Proficiency in Figma and modern prototyping tools, with an interest in using AI tools to support and improve the design process.

  • Ability to work through design challenges and translate complexity into simple, intuitive, scalable and user-friendly experiences.

  • A passion for creating great user experiences and for validating and iterating on designs to ensure they address user needs.

  • Ability to translate product goals and user needs into thoughtful design solutions, from early concepts through to implementation details.

  • A collaborative and iterative approach to design, with openness to feedback and working closely with others.

  • A growth mindset and interest in developing a deep understanding of educational UX for a product designed for medical experts rather than a general audience.

  • Experience using research insights and data to inform design decisions and participating in user research studies.

  • Experience working effectively in cross-functional teams, including product, design, engineering, and research, and collaborating with a range of stakeholders.

You enjoy:

  • Digging into complex UX problems and experimenting to find simple, effective solutions for users.

  • Working collaboratively with Product, Engineering, Medical, Research, plus commercial teams, rather than designing in isolation.

  • Using research, data, and feedback to challenge assumptions and improve your designs.

  • Moving from early concepts to detailed interaction and UI design.

  • Learning about complex domains and developing empathy for highly knowledgeable, specialist users.

  • Design systems and contributing to it

  • Giving and receiving constructive design feedback and learning from other designers.

  • Exploring new tools and ways of working, including AI, and thoughtfully applying them to your design process.

This is your opportunity to own a real product at a company building something genuinely new. As our Senior Product Manager, you join a small, senior product team at a stage where one person's judgment visibly shapes the product.

You will own product topics end to end: understanding the customer, deciding what is worth building and why, shaping the concept, and seeing it through to a shipped result that delivers value. You do this for your own set of topics, alongside our Director Product Management and our CPO, who both work hands-on. You start by owning the flow of customer requests and insights, the fastest way to learn our product and our customers, and grow over the first 6 to 12 months into owning whole product areas with the same autonomy. You develop the product; our
engineers build it.

We are building a product in a new category, so there is no playbook to copy. The work is genuinely conceptual: understand how digital B2B products work, understand our users' problems, and invent viable solutions. Our engineering team works closely and continuously with product, no throwing specs over a wall, and most of that collaboration happens remotely.

If you want real ownership, the influence to shape a product from an early stage, and the discipline of a spec-driven, high-bar team, this is the right moment to join.


What will be your responsibility

  • Own a set of product topics end to end, from the customer problem through to a shipped result that delivers real value
  • Decide what is worth building and in what order for your topics, shape the concept, and drive it through delivery together with engineering
  • Run discovery with customers to understand what they actually need, test your assumptions rather than building on guesses, and turn what you learn into clear product decisions
  • Own the flow of customer requests and insights: make sense of what customers are asking for, decide what it means for the product, route it to the right place, and turn a stream of raw input into clear product direction
  • Translate real problems into clear, well-scoped, buildable definitions, working spec-driven (currently with OpenSpec) at a high bar
  • Invent viable product concepts in a category with no existing product to copy
  • Shape the UX and UI together with engineering, based on the existing product and the component library - we have no dedicated designer in the team
  • Work hand in hand with our remote engineering team throughout the build rather than through handover: analyse a solution for gaps and edge cases before it is built, using AI where it helps, and after shipping, check whether the outcome delivered its intended value and works for users



What you'll need

  • A track record of owning B2B SaaS products end to end, from customer problem to shipped outcome, with real accountability for whether they delivered value
  • A genuine understanding of how digital B2B products work, and the ability to invent viable concepts rather than copy existing patterns
  • Strong requirements and scoping judgment: you make vague problems complete, unambiguous and correctly scoped, and you know what to leave out
  • A structured, process-driven way of working, paired with genuine comfort in a fast, unstructured startup environment
  • Fluent, daily use of AI tools (Claude or equivalent) as a normal part of how you think, write specs and
    analyse problems, since we're an AI-first team and expect the same of you.
  • Experience working in a spec-driven environment (OpenSpec or similar); turning fuzzy intent into rigorous, complete, buildable definition is second nature to you
  • Data-model fluency: you reason comfortably about entities and how they relate, enough to break problems down and hold a real bar with engineering
  • Technical fluency: not afraid of a terminal, and able to reason about data flows, system constraints, and how an agentic product behaves
  • Proven experience collaborating closely with a remote engineering team
  • Fluent in English; professional German is a strong plus given our customers



What we'll offer you

  • Remote-first setup, Europe-based so we stay reasonably timezone-aligned, with access to our Munich office and backyard workspace
  • Flexible working hours and a "take what you need" vacation policy
  • Direct collaboration with our Director Product Management and CPO, and real ownership of your own product areas
  • Competitive salary plus virtual ESOP, so you grow with us
  • A team of motivated, kind, and inspiring colleagues
  • A role in a growing SaaS company in the Data & AI space, joining at the ideal moment to make a lasting impact
  • Regular team events and some friendly Spikeball or Table Tennis matches



Extra props for

  • Experience in the Data, Analytics, or AI space
  • Experience with AI or agentic products
  • Experience building in a new or emerging product category
  • Experience working in a remote-first team
  • Curiosity for technology and innovation
  • Strong Spikeball or Table Tennis skills (our signature Mindfuel games)

title: Interim project - Senior DevOps Consultant (f/m/d)
description:
Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.
  • A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context.
Nice to have:
  • S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph).
  • Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools.
  • Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM).
  • Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information.
  • Some experience deploying AI projects.
Qualifications
You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills:
  • You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud).
  • Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.
  • You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment.
  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).
  • Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in English.


Our offer

Conditions
Application Deadline: The position remains open until filledExpected start of assignment: As soon as possible, by mutual agreement.Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignmentTerms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement.

title: VP, Growth
description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing?

  • Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

  • Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand

  • Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts

  • Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does

  • Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment

  • Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows

  • Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts

  • Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned

  • Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it

What do we need from you?

  • Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport

  • A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for

  • Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative

  • Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel

  • Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months

  • Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board

  • The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model

  • Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step

  • Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture

  • Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue

  • International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages

  • Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup

Our culture and what we offer 🌍

We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way.

Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🏥 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and continuous learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 📈 The chance to join a company in its exponential expansion phase

Benefits vary by country of employment - your recruiter will walk you through the specifics for your location.

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the global industry we serve. We welcome applications regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let it stop you - if you think you'd thrive here, we'd rather hear from you than not.
